reasoning_content: The zip contains a top-level `liquibase` script and `liquibase.bat`, plus probably a `lib/` folder and other things. `ls -d liquibase-5.0.4` failed. So the zip extracts its contents directly to the root (liquibase, liquibase.bat, lib/, etc.). Let's create a directory, move the extracted files in, and run it.

action.command: cd /opt && ls | grep -iE "liquibase|^lib|LICENSE|NOTICE|NOTICE.txt" | head -20; mkdir -p /opt/liquibase-5.0.4 && mv liquibase liquibase.bat /opt/liquibase-5.0.4/ && [ -d lib ] && mv lib /opt/liquibase-5.0.4/ ; ls /opt/liquibase-5.0.4 | head
